title: 电价低20%：远景这笔账，怎么算的
speaker: Ricky Jung

segments.en: Ricky, how does this change the cost of building and running a data center? I think many people are wondering if you power this purely through renewables, how does that change the commercial viability of running one or multiple?
segments.zh: Ricky，这对数据中心的建设和运营成本有何影响？很多人想知道，如果完全依靠可再生能源供电，对运营一个或多个数据中心的商业可行性有何改变？

segments.en: Yeah, actually the cost is very a lot of the very important factors in all the consideration.
segments.zh: 是的，实际上成本是所有考量中非常重要的因素之一。

segments.en: Actually, we compare with the very traditional way of getting the power, our power price compared with the grid could be like 20% lower.
segments.zh: 实际上，与传统获取电力的方式相比，我们的电价相比电网可能低20%。

segments.en: But of course, it's one of the important things, but not the only one. Actually, the renewable also solves some of the challenges for the kind of energy consumption constraints, because you know the fast growing speed of the data center is even surpass all of the kind of construction for the grid infrastructure.
segments.zh: 当然，这是重要因素之一，但不是唯一。可再生能源还解决了能源消耗限制的一些挑战，因为数据中心的快速增长甚至超过了电网基础设施的建设。

segments.en: So which brings a lot of challenges to the local community and the grid infrastructure. So we try to make a new incremental a new extra power supply so that we can just solve the burden and the pressure to the local community energy consumption.
segments.zh: 这给当地社区和电网基础设施带来了许多挑战。因此，我们尝试创造新的增量电力供应，以减轻当地社区能源消耗的负担和压力。

segments.en: So we are not going to just conflict with local community and other industries. We bring in some new energy supplies.
segments.zh: 我们不会与当地社区和其他行业冲突，而是引入一些新的能源供应。
